lunch3_start.name: {name}
lunch3_start.text: *Lunchtime. Today, unusually — all three are gathered in one place.*

lunch3_start_2.name: {name}
lunch3_start_2.text: *{name} opens the lunch box. Seoyeon naturally sits beside, Dain plops down across, and Yuna sneaks in from the corner munching her bread.*

lunch3_meal_3.name: Seoyeon
lunch3_meal_3.text: The rolled omelette is a bit too salty. 6 points.

lunch3_meal_5.name: Seoyeon
lunch3_meal_5.text: Out of 10. That's not bad, you know?

lunch3_meal_6.name: {name}
lunch3_meal_6.text: *Yuna silently reaches out with her chopsticks and takes the best-looking sausage.*

lunch3_meal_10.name: {name}
lunch3_meal_10.text: *One side dish remains. The last rolled omelette.*

lunch3_choice.name: {name}
lunch3_choice.text: *I ponder who to give the last side dish to.*

lunch3_give_seo_1.name: Seoyeon
lunch3_give_seo_1.text: ...Thanks. You do have a sense for these things.

lunch3_give_dain_2.name: Seoyeon
lunch3_give_dain_2.text: ...Unbelievable. And here I even rated it for you.

lunch3_give_yuna_2.name: Seoyeon
lunch3_give_yuna_2.text: ...I thought you'd give it to me.

lunch3_harem_1.name: {name}
lunch3_harem_1.text: *The three of us shared it. No one gets angry right away. Still, none of them looks comfortable. We only pushed it off for today.*

lunch3_expose_1.name: {name}
lunch3_expose_1.text: *The moment I said let's all share — Dain spoke first.*

lunch3_expose_2.name: Dain
lunch3_expose_2.text: Oh right! {name}, we're going to the arcade this weekend!! What should we eat before?!

lunch3_expose_4.name: {name}
lunch3_expose_4.text: *Seoyeon's chopsticks stop. Yuna's hand tearing bread stops.*

lunch3_expose_6.name: Seoyeon
lunch3_expose_6.text: You told me you had somewhere to go together.

lunch3_expose_7.name: Dain
lunch3_expose_7.text: ...Wait. You told me you'd hang out this weekend too?

lunch3_expose_11.name: Yuna
lunch3_expose_11.text: ...That was a lie. I didn't know either.

lunch3_expose_12.name: {name}
lunch3_expose_12.text: *Three pairs of chopsticks freeze mid-air. The cafeteria noise suddenly sounds far away.*

lunch3_expose_13.name: {name}
lunch3_expose_13.text: *From the next table, Minsu is watching. He shakes his head.*

lunch3_expose_15.name: {name}
lunch3_expose_15.text: *I can't say a word. Minsu is right.*

lunch3_expose_choice.name: {name}
choices: I'm sorry. You're all such great people, I couldn't say no.
The times are different, so I thought it'd be fine...

lunch3_expose_honest_1.name: {name}
lunch3_expose_honest_1.text: I'm sorry. You're all such great people, I couldn't say no.

lunch3_expose_honest_2.name: Seoyeon
lunch3_expose_honest_2.text: ...Couldn't say no. That's the cruelest thing you could say, {name}.

lunch3_expose_honest_3.name: Seoyeon
lunch3_expose_honest_3.text: Kindness that can't refuse — gives false hope.

lunch3_expose_honest_5.name: Seoyeon
lunch3_expose_honest_5.text: I don't settle for being just one of many. — If that's how it is, I'd rather have nothing at all.

lunch3_expose_honest_7.name: {name}
lunch3_expose_honest_7.text: *No exclamation marks. — The exclamation marks have vanished from Dain's sentences. For the first time.*

lunch3_expose_excuse_1.name: {name}
lunch3_expose_excuse_1.text: The times are different, so I thought it'd be fine...

lunch3_expose_excuse_2.name: Seoyeon
lunch3_expose_excuse_2.text: ...You don't see how that's the problem?

lunch3_expose_excuse_3.name: Dain
lunch3_expose_excuse_3.text: Give me some time to think too.

lunch3_expose_excuse_4.name: {name}
lunch3_expose_excuse_4.text: *Dain turns her head away. She hasn't touched her soboro bread.*

lunch3_expose_run_1.name: {name}
lunch3_expose_run_1.text: *I ran. From the classroom. — The most cowardly choice.*

lunch3_expose_run_2.name: {name}
lunch3_expose_run_2.text: *Behind me, the silence of three people pierces my back.*

lunch3_share_1.name: {name}
lunch3_share_1.text: *I suggested we all share. There are smiles, but the air feels strangely heavy. All three of them are pretending this is fine.*

lunch3_seo_skin_1.name: {name}
lunch3_seo_skin_1.text: *While eating lunch, a grain of rice sticks to my lip. Seoyeon reaches over and picks it off.*

lunch3_seo_skin_2.name: Seoyeon
lunch3_seo_skin_2.text: ...Pay more attention when eating in front of people.

lunch3_seo_skin_3.name: {name}
lunch3_seo_skin_3.text: *After pulling her hand back, Seoyeon drops her chopsticks. — It looked natural, but her fingertips were trembling slightly.*

lunch3_seo_witness_1.name: {name}
lunch3_seo_witness_1.text: *Dain stops at the classroom door. She sees Seoyeon receiving the lunchbox. ...Oh. She turns back.*

lunch3_seo_witness_choice.name: {name}
lunch3_seo_witness_choice.text: *Dain's back is disappearing down the hallway.*

lunch3_seo_chase_dain_1.name: {name}
lunch3_seo_chase_dain_1.text: *Seoyeon sets down the lunchbox. Her face is expressionless.*

lunch3_dain_skin_1.name: {name}
lunch3_dain_skin_1.text: *Dain wins the lunch bet and throws her arms open in excitement. She hugs me. One second.*

lunch3_dain_skin_2.name: {name}
lunch3_dain_skin_2.text: *Dain springs away. Her ears are red.*

lunch3_dain_witness_1.name: {name}
lunch3_dain_witness_1.text: *Yuna passes by the hallway and glances into the gym. Dain is laughing. Yuna quickens her pace.*

lunch3_yuna_skin_1.name: {name}
lunch3_yuna_skin_1.text: *While handing me a note, Yuna grabs my hand. She doesn't let go.*

lunch3_yuna_skin_2.name: Yuna
lunch3_yuna_skin_2.text: ...This isn't about what's on the note. Just.

lunch3_yuna_skin_3.name: {name}
lunch3_yuna_skin_3.text: *She only lets go after the sentence ends.*

lunch3_yuna_witness_1.name: Seoyeon
lunch3_yuna_witness_1.text: I heard lunchbox smell coming from the library. ...With Yuna?

lunch3_yuna_witness_2.name: {name}
lunch3_yuna_witness_2.text: *Her expression is blank. That makes it scarier.*

lunch3_start_2_ins.name: Dain
lunch3_start_2_ins.text: *Chomping into the rolled omelette without hesitation* Oh! This is good!!

lunch3_meal_10_ins.name: {name}
lunch3_meal_10_ins.text: *Let's all eat together, I said. — But the mood feels off.*

lunch3_meal_10_ins2.name: {name}
lunch3_meal_10_ins2.text: *After the other two leave, I'm alone with the one I chose. — I didn't know choosing could feel this heavy.*

lunch3_meal_10_ins3.name: {name}
lunch3_meal_10_ins3.text: *Seoyeon's chopsticks pause. She composes herself. The student council president's face returns. — I know it's not fine. I feel bad.*

lunch3_meal_10_ins4.name: {name}
lunch3_meal_10_ins4.text: *All together?! Great!! The exclamation marks are alive. — But her voice is half a tone lower. Normally she'd be dragging chairs over, but today she doesn't move from her seat.*

lunch3_meal_10_ins5.name: {name}
lunch3_meal_10_ins5.text: *Yuna just nods. She writes on a note, folds it, and puts it in her pocket. Doesn't hand it over. — No idea what it said.*

lunch3_expose_7_ins.name: {name}
lunch3_expose_7_ins.text: *The last one quietly sets hers down.*

lunch3_expose_honest_4_ins.name: {name}
lunch3_expose_honest_4_ins.text: *Seoyeon's expression changes. — Still calm, but there's an edge to it now.*

lunch3_expose_run_2_ins.name: {name}
lunch3_expose_run_2_ins.text: *Lunch ended, afternoon classes continued. The chalk on the blackboard sounds unusually far away. I feel someone's gaze on my back. — There's still an unfinished story left.*
